group_message_sources.no_comm: No injected message; historical prompt behavior is not replaced by the current no_comm fix.
group_message_sources.random: Generated Gaussian message, target length/norm matched; not a Sender plan.
group_message_sources.text: Same cached Sender plan token embeddings, terminal EOS excluded; no Adapter.

sender_prompt_audit.limitation: Saved prompts and cache configuration establish recorded inputs; the original Sender command and exact source commit were not retained here.
